The '''Valau''' were a tribe of [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to [[Nagoa]], a location in the remote corners of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] during<ref name="Codex" /> the [[Sith Wars/Legends|Sith Wars]]<ref name="Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and various [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] factions.<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> As they were far from the influence of the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], the Valau were able to develop their own views on [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]; the Valau considered [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] to be marked by their [[God/Legends|gods]] and chosen to serve as instruments of their gods' wills.<ref name="Codex" />

Valau Force-users underwent intense rituals to shed their identities so that they could act only as conduits for their gods. As they believed that their gods were unquestionable, they had no concept of the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light]] or [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark sides]] of the Force, and they viewed it as a tool.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Valau were mentioned in the Codex entry "The Force: Beyond Light and Dark," which is acquired in Chapter XII of the [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire|''Knights of the Fallen Empire'']] Digital Expansion to the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Codex" /> Chapter XII was added to the game in [[2016]] as part of Update 4.3.<ref name="Patch">{{TORweb/Patch|4.3}}</ref>
